0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Nets hosting the Hornets, and Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), all listed as out. The Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, and their most recent meeting, on March 31, 2026 in Brooklyn, ended 117-86.
